blocks.rationale: Jointly address all three trigger failures while preserving the successful Wisconsin exemption behavior: add a clause-specific §3306(c)(5) family-service helper, revise the airline calculator to select route- and cabin-specific schedules, and extend the installed exemption planner to the solved Federal-and-Pennsylvania regime without changing its Illinois or Federal-and-Wisconsin branches.
